Hu-Friedy

Perma Sharp sutures

  From $73.99
Suture needles are made from Series 300 Stainless Steel, the ideal alloy for dental sutures. This alloy allows a very fine point geometry, stays sharp throughout the suturing procedure and is less likely to bend and more resistant to breakage. In addition, the needles have a high-polished finish for a smoother penetration.   For Perma Sharp® Sutures Chart along with additional information, click here.

Description

Suture needles are made from Series 300 Stainless Steel, the ideal alloy for dental sutures. This alloy allows a very fine point geometry, stays sharp throughout the suturing procedure and is less likely to bend and more resistant to breakage. In addition, the needles have a high-polished finish for a smoother penetration.
 
For Perma Sharp® Sutures Chart along with additional information, click here.
